description: This file defines the IconState and related enums used for representing various activity and role states in the application's UI. It includes states for different types of activities and tools, and methods for deriving display symbols and prominence levels.

methods.name: badgeSymbolName
methods.description: Returns the name of the symbol representing the current icon state, based on associated activities or tools.

methods.name: badgeProminence
methods.description: Determines the prominence level of the badge (primary, secondary, overridden) based on the activity.

methods.name: isWorking
methods.description: Indicates whether the icon state represents an active working state.

methods.name: toIconState
methods.description: Converts an IconOverrideSelection value into the corresponding IconState.
